text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area rose slightly in the week ending Oct 24, an industry source said. The following are estimated levels, with week-ago and year-ago levels.
All figures in thousands of tonnes.
Motor gasoline saw no incoming supply and some cargo sales transatlantic and to northern Europe, and on barges into Germany.
Naphtha stocks were steady, but saw large throughput into the petrochemical industry.
Gas oil saw incoming material from the U.S. and ex-Soviet Union, and outgoing sales into Germany, Swizerland and Belgium.
Fuel oil saw incoming straight-run supplies from the ex-Soviet Union, and sales into the bunker market. Sales of cracked material were reported into Germany.
